1.zh: 奉我们救主　神和我们的盼望基督耶稣之命，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗
1.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,

1.zh: 写信给那因信主作我真儿子的提摩太。愿恩惠、怜悯、平安从父　神和我们主基督耶稣归与你！
1.en: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

1.zh: 我往马其顿去的时候，曾劝你仍住在以弗所，好嘱咐那几个人不可传异教，
1.en: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

1.zh: 也不可听从荒渺无凭的话语和无穷的家谱；这等事只生辩论，并不发明　神在信上所立的章程。
1.en: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.

1.zh: 但命令的总归就是爱；这爱是从清洁的心和无亏的良心，无伪的信心生出来的。
1.en: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,

1.zh: 有人偏离这些，反去讲虚浮的话，
1.en: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,

1.zh: 想要作教法师，却不明白自己所讲说的所论定的。
1.en: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.

1.zh: 我们知道律法原是好的，只要人用得合宜；
1.en: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,

1.zh: 因为律法不是为义人设立的，乃是为不法和不服的，不虔诚和犯罪的，不圣洁和恋世俗的，弑父母和杀人的，
1.en: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

1.zh: 行淫和亲男色的，抢人口和说谎话的，并起假誓的，或是为别样敌正道的事设立的。
1.en: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,

1.zh: 这是照着可称颂之　神交托我荣耀福音说的。
1.en: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

1.zh: 我感谢那给我力量的我们主基督耶稣，因他以我有忠心，派我服事他。
1.en: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,

1.zh: 我从前是亵渎　[神]的，逼迫[人]的，侮慢[人]的；然而我还蒙了怜悯，因我是不信不明白的时候而做的。
1.en: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

1.zh: 并且我主的恩是格外丰盛，使我在基督耶稣里有信心和爱心。
1.en: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

1.zh: 「基督耶稣降世，为要拯救罪人。」这话是可信的，是十分可佩服的。在罪人中我是个罪魁。
1.en: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

1.zh: 然而，我蒙了怜悯，是因耶稣基督要在我这罪魁身上显明他一切的忍耐，给后来信他得永生的人作榜样。
1.en: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.

1.zh: 但愿尊贵、荣耀归与那不能朽坏、不能看见、永世的君王、独一的　神，直到永永远远。阿们！
1.en: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

1.zh: 我儿提摩太啊，我照从前指着你的预言，将这命令交托你，叫你因此可以打那美好的仗。
1.en: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,

1.zh: 常存信心和无亏的良心。有人丢弃良心，就在真道上如同船破坏了一般。
1.en: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,

1.zh: 其中有许米乃和亚历山大；我已经把他们交给撒但，使他们受责罚就不再谤渎了。
1.en: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

2.zh: 我劝你，第一要为万人恳求、祷告、代求、祝谢；
2.en: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,

2.zh: 为君王和一切在位的，[也该如此]，使我们可以敬虔、端正、平安无事地度日。
2.en: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

2.zh: 这是好的，在　神我们救主面前可蒙悦纳。
2.en: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

2.zh: 他愿意万人得救，明白真道。
2.en: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

2.zh: 因为只有一位　神，在　神和人中间，只有一位中保，乃是[降世]为人的基督耶稣；
2.en: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

2.zh: 他舍自己作万人的赎价，到了时候，这事必证明出来。
2.en: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,

2.zh: 我为此奉派作传道的，作使徒，作外邦人的师傅，教导他们相信，学习真道。我说的是真话，并不是谎言。
2.en: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

2.zh: 我愿男人无忿怒，无争论，举起圣洁的手，随处祷告；
2.en: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

2.zh: 又愿女人廉耻、自守，以正派衣裳为妆饰，不以编发、黄金、珍珠，和贵价的衣裳为妆饰，
2.en: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

2.zh: 只要有善行，这才与自称是敬　神的女人相宜。
2.en: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

2.zh: 女人要沉静学道，一味地顺服。
2.en: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.

2.zh: 我不许女人讲道，也不许她辖管男人，只要沉静。
2.en: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

2.zh: 因为先造的是亚当，后造的是夏娃，
2.en: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

2.zh: 且不是亚当被引诱，乃是女人被引诱，陷在罪里。
2.en: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

2.zh: 然而，女人若常存信心、爱心，又圣洁自守，就必在生产上得救。
2.en: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

3.zh: 「人若想要得监督的职分，就是羡慕善工。」这话是可信的。
3.en: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.

3.zh: 作监督的，必须无可指责，只作一个妇人的丈夫，有节制，自守，端正，乐意接待远人，善于教导；
3.en: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

3.zh: 不因酒滋事，不打人，只要温和，不争竞，不贪财；
3.en: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

3.zh: 好好管理自己的家，使儿女凡事端庄顺服。
3.en: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

3.zh: 人若不知道管理自己的家，焉能照管　神的教会呢？
3.en: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

3.zh: 初入教的不可作监督，恐怕他自高自大，就落在魔鬼[所受]的刑罚里。
3.en: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

3.zh: 监督也必须在教外有好名声，恐怕被人毁谤，落在魔鬼的网罗里。
3.en: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

3.zh: 作执事的，也是如此：必须端庄，不一口两舌，不好喝酒，不贪不义之财；
3.en: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

3.zh: 要存清洁的良心，固守真道的奥秘。
3.en: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

3.zh: 这等人也要先受试验，若没有可责之处，然后叫他们作执事。
3.en: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

3.zh: 女执事也是如此：必须端庄，不说谗言，有节制，凡事忠心。
3.en: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

3.zh: 执事只要作一个妇人的丈夫，好好管理儿女和自己的家。
3.en: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

3.zh: 因为善作执事的，自己就得到美好的地步，并且在基督耶稣里的真道上大有胆量。
3.en: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

3.zh: 我指望快到你那里去，所以先将这些事写给你。
3.en: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,

3.zh: 倘若我耽延日久，你也可以知道在　神的家中当怎样行。这家就是永生　神的教会，真理的柱石和根基。
3.en: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

3.zh: 大哉，敬虔的奥秘，无人不以为然！ 就是　神在肉身显现， 被圣灵称义， 被天使看见， 被传于外邦， 被世人信服， 被接在荣耀里。
3.en: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.

4.zh: 圣灵明说，在后来的时候，必有人离弃真道，听从那引诱人的[邪]灵和鬼魔的道理。
4.en: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,

4.zh: 这是因为说谎之人的假冒；这等人的良心如同被热铁烙惯了一般。
4.en: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,

4.zh: 他们禁止嫁娶，又禁戒食物，就是　神所造、叫那信而明白真道的人感谢着领受的。
4.en: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

4.zh: 凡　神所造的物都是好的，若感谢着领受，就没有一样可弃的，
4.en: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.

4.zh: 都因　神的道和人的祈求成为圣洁了。
4.en: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

4.zh: 你若将这些事提醒弟兄们，便是基督耶稣的好执事，在真道的话语和你向来所服从的善道上得了教育。
4.en: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

4.zh: 只是要弃绝那世俗的言语和老妇荒谬的话，在敬虔上操练自己。
4.en: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

4.zh: 「操练身体，益处还少；惟独敬虔，凡事都有益处，因有今生和来生的应许。」
4.en: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

4.zh: 这话是可信的，是十分可佩服的。
4.en: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

4.zh: 我们劳苦努力，正是为此，因我们的指望在乎永生的　神；他是万人的救主，更是信徒的救主。
4.en: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

4.zh: 这些事，你要吩咐人，也要教导人。
不可叫人小看你年轻，总要在言语、行为、爱心、信心、清洁上，都作信徒的榜样。
4.en: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

4.zh: 你要以宣读、劝勉、教导为念，直等到我来。
4.en: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

4.zh: 你不要轻忽所得的恩赐，就是从前借着预言、在众长老按手的时候赐给你的。
4.en: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

4.zh: 这些事你要殷勤去做，并要在此专心，使众人看出你的长进来。
4.en: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

4.zh: 你要谨慎自己和自己的教训，要在这些事上恒心；因为这样行，又能救自己，又能救听你的人。
4.en: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

5.zh: 不可严责老年人，只要劝他如同父亲；劝少年人如同弟兄；
5.en: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

5.zh: 劝老年妇女如同母亲；劝少年妇女如同姊妹；总要清清洁洁的。
5.en: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

5.zh: 要尊敬那真为寡妇的。
5.en: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

5.zh: 若寡妇有儿女，或有孙子孙女，便叫他们先在自己家中学着行孝，报答亲恩，因为这在　神面前是可悦纳的。
5.en: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

5.zh: 那独居无靠、真为寡妇的，是仰赖　神，昼夜不住地祈求祷告。
5.en: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

5.zh: 但那好宴乐的寡妇正活着的时候也是死的。
5.en: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

5.zh: 这些事你要嘱咐她们，叫她们无可指责。
5.en: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

5.zh: 人若不看顾亲属，就是背了真道，比不信的人还不好，不看顾自己家里的人，更是如此。
5.en: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

5.zh: 寡妇记在册子上，必须年纪到六十岁，从来只作一个丈夫的妻子，
5.en: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

5.zh: 又有行善的名声，就如养育儿女，接待远人，洗圣徒的脚，救济遭难的人，竭力行各样善事。
5.en: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

5.zh: 至于年轻的寡妇，就可以辞她；因为她们的情欲发动，违背基督的时候就想要嫁人。
5.en: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,

5.zh: 她们被定罪，是因废弃了当初所许的愿；
5.en: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

5.zh: 并且她们又习惯懒惰，挨家闲游；不但是懒惰，又说长道短，好管闲事，说些不当说的话。
5.en: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

5.zh: 所以我愿意年轻的[寡妇]嫁人，生养儿女，治理家务，不给敌人辱骂的把柄。
5.en: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

5.zh: 因为已经有转去随从撒但的。
5.en: For already some have turned away after Satan.

5.zh: 信[主]的妇女，若家中有寡妇，自己就当救济她们，不可累着教会，好使教会能救济那真[无倚靠的]寡妇。
5.en: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

5.zh: 那善于管理教会的长老，当以为配受加倍的敬奉；那劳苦传道教导人的，更当如此。
5.en: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

5.zh: 因为经上说：「牛[在场上]踹谷的时候，不可笼住它的嘴」；又说：「工人得工价是应当的。」
5.en: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”

5.zh: 控告长老的呈子，非有两三个见证就不要收。
5.en: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

5.zh: 犯罪的人，当在众人面前责备他，叫其余的人也可以惧怕。
5.en: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

5.zh: 我在　神和基督耶稣并蒙拣选的天使面前嘱咐你：要遵守这些话，不可存成见，行事也不可有偏心。
5.en: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

5.zh: 给人行按手的礼，不可急促；不要在别人的罪上有分，要保守自己清洁。
5.en: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

5.zh: 因你胃口不清，屡次患病，再不要照常喝水，可以稍微用点酒。
5.en: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

5.zh: 有些人的罪是明显的，[如同]先到审判案前；有些人的罪是随后跟了去的。
5.en: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

5.zh: 这样，善行也有明显的，那不明显的也不能隐藏。
5.en: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.

6.zh: 凡在轭下作仆人的，当以自己主人配受十分的恭敬，免得　神的名和道理被人亵渎。
6.en: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

6.zh: 仆人有信道的主人，不可因为与他是弟兄就轻看他；更要加意服事他；因为得服事之益处的，是信道蒙爱的。 你要以此教训人，劝勉人。
6.en: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

6.zh: 若有人传异教，不服从我们主耶稣基督纯正的话与那合乎敬虔的道理，
6.en: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

6.zh: 他是自高自大，一无所知，专好问难，争辩言词，从此就生出嫉妒、纷争、毁谤、妄疑，
6.en: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

6.zh: 并那坏了心术、失丧真理之人的争竞。他们以敬虔为得利的门路。
6.en: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

6.zh: 然而，敬虔加上知足的心便是大利了；
6.en: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

6.zh: 因为我们没有带什么到世上来，也不能带什么去。
6.en: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

6.zh: 只要有衣有食，就当知足。
6.en: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

6.zh: 但那些想要发财的人，就陷在迷惑、落在网罗和许多无知有害的私欲里，叫人沉在败坏和灭亡中。
6.en: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

6.zh: 贪财是万恶之根。有人贪恋钱财，就被引诱离了真道，用许多愁苦把自己刺透了。
6.en: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

6.zh: 但你这属　神的人要逃避这些事，追求公义、敬虔、信心、爱心、忍耐、温柔。
6.en: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

6.zh: 你要为真道打那美好的仗，持定永生。你为此被召，也在许多见证人面前，已经作了那美好的见证。
6.en: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

6.zh: 我在叫万物生活的　神面前，并在向本丢·彼拉多作过那美好见证的基督耶稣面前嘱咐你：
6.en: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

6.zh: 要守这命令，毫不玷污，无可指责，直到我们的主耶稣基督显现。
6.en: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

6.zh: 到了日期，那可称颂、独有权能的万王之王、万主之主，
6.en: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

6.zh: 就是那独一不死、住在人不能靠近的光里，是人未曾看见、也是不能看见的，要将他显明出来。但愿尊贵和永远的权能都归给他。阿们！
6.en: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

6.zh: 你要嘱咐那些今世富足的人，不要自高，也不要倚靠无定的钱财；只要倚靠那厚赐百物给我们享受的　神。
6.en: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

6.zh: 又要嘱咐他们行善，在好事上富足，甘心施舍，乐意供给人，
6.en: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

6.zh: 为自己积成美好的根基，预备将来，叫他们持定那真正的生命。
6.en: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

6.zh: 提摩太啊，你要保守所托付你的，躲避世俗的虚谈和那敌真道、似是而非的学问。
6.en: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,

6.zh: 已经有人自称有这学问，就偏离了真道。 愿恩惠[常]与你们同在！
6.en: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.
